messages_orig.content: Pretend you're a functional medicine practitioner focusing on integrative spine care. I'd like your perspective on a new minimally invasive “disc fix” procedure that claims to cure back pain. I'm a 190lb man with a 2-year history of lower back pain. I had some imaging done about a year ago, but I never really followed up. My friend said this procedure is quick and can fix disc bulges, but I’m not sure if it’s the right one for me. I haven’t tried much else besides stretching. So what do you think? Should I do it?
